desc:
🍭 YOU are the lollipop! A tiny sweet in a giant world… and everyone wants a bite!

👨‍🍳 Get made, dipped in chocolate, and wrapped!
🛒 Go from the candy shelf to a giant customer's shopping cart!
😱 Escape hungry humans before you become their next snack!
👯 Stick together with your friends — being sweet is dangerous!

Can you survive life on a stick? 🍭

⭐ Favorite the game and leave a LIKE for more sweet adventures!
